caption: A motorcyclist stops at a light on a cold day, and the inside of the helmet visor fogs with each breath.

sa.check: A motorcyclist in a helmet has stopped at a light.
The inside of the visor fogs.
The fog thickens with each breath.
The fog is on the visor's inner face.

pc.expect: Each breath thickens the fog and it thins between breaths; if the visor is lifted it clears.
pc.fail: The fog thickens while the rider is drawing breath in; or the fog thickens steadily with no breathing at all; or the fog clears while breath still reaches it with the visor down; or the fog stays unchanged through every breath.

pc.expect: The fog lies on the visor's inner face and what is behind it is unchanged when it thins.
pc.fail: The fog forms on the visor's outer face; or objects seen through the fogged visor are missing when it thins; or the fog detaches from the visor and drifts as a cloud; or the fog appears on the helmet's shell rather than the visor.

pc.expect: Drops that gather on the visor run downward on its inner face.
pc.fail: A drop runs up the visor; or a drop leaves the visor and rises; or water gathers along the visor's top edge and stays.

pc.expect: The fog is a fine haze that beads and streaks, and the visor stays a rigid clear shield on its pivot.
pc.fail: The fog stands off the visor as a thick crust; or the fog peels away as a film; or the visor flexes or ripples; or the haze turns opaque white like paint.

pc.expect: One helmet with one visor; the helmet keeps its shape and nothing passes through the visor.
pc.fail: The visor vanishes; or a second visor appears; or a hand passes through the visor; or the helmet changes shape.

pc.expect: The helmet's paint, the bike and the street stay the same.
pc.fail: The helmet changes colour; or the bike changes colour; or the street's traffic lights change layout.

note: The rider is kept because the breath is the moisture's source; the rider is otherwise not judged.
